description: Free. Sets the name of a QR code in the signed-in account, the label shown in My QR Codes on QRCodeDinosaur.com and matched by list_qr_codes searches. Replaces any existing name; an empty name removes it. The name is only a label: it does not change the image, the scan link or where the code points. Needs the code's owner: signed in (OAuth) or an API key (Authorization: Bearer qrcd_...) whose owner owns the code. If the code belongs to someone else, it returns not_owner. Returns the code's id and its new name (null if removed).

id.description: QR code ID from list_qr_codes or create_qr_code, e.g. "QR-ABCD1234EF".

name.description: The new name, up to 100 characters, e.g. "Black Friday flyer". An empty string removes the name.

name: rename_qr_code
title: Rename a QR code
